title: Different correspondence defects survive composition repair
claim: In the selected case-one correspondence miss, minimal composition repair does not rescue the retained pipeline; q04 has excluded search support while q01/q06 exhibit objective disagreement. Two predeclared fresh attempts split, including a pass that limits claims of stable difficulty.
limitations: One retrospectively selected miss and two predeclared fresh attempts on one case; no population rate or dense-field validation.
Counterfactuals and reference-neighbourhood searches are privileged diagnostics; finite optimization is not global proof.
Historical replay used an identical-Dockerfile replacement image; its reconstructed stages are not original intermediate dumps.
Manual-reference ambiguity is not clinically adjudicated; public annotation exposure cannot be excluded.
